summary: This directory manages the configuration interfaces for various execution processes within the system. It defines specialized option sets for AI tasks, general analysis procedures, and retry mechanisms to control behavior, debugging, and state management during execution.
responsibilities: Define schema for configuration options used across execution modules
Specify retry behavior parameters and observation hooks
Extend base execution configuration with domain-specific settings
Provide standardized interfaces for metadata and debug control
relationships: The core execution options serve as a foundation that specialized interfaces like AI and analysis options extend.
Retry options define logic that dictates how execution processes handle failures through attempt limits and observer interfaces.
designDecisions: Use of TypeScript interfaces to enforce configuration schema
Interface inheritance for extending base execution capabilities
Observer pattern implementation for retry event monitoring
